page.overview:
Who is The Big Bad Hippo?

During his time as a wrestler, he was one of the most recognizable competitors in the Earth Rumble tournaments due to his extremely large size and distinctive manner of speaking. He often omitted determiners and articles when he talked, turning "Hippo mad!" into his catchphrase. Like The Boulder, The Hippo also referred to himself in the third person.

Team Avatar first witnessed The Big Bad Hippo in action during the first round of the sixth edition of the Earth Rumble tournaments, where he faced The Boulder. The Hippo demonstrated his unique fighting style by catching a rock The Boulder launched at him between his teeth, chewing it up, and spitting it out before initiating his signature move, "rocking the boat". This maneuver proved highly effective, causing The Boulder to stagger backward and nearly fall out of the ring. At the last moment, however, The Boulder recovered and hurled a large slab of earth at The Hippo. Despite his immense durability, which allowed him to withstand the direct hit seemingly unharmed, The Boulder ultimately defeated him by lifting both The Hippo and the earth beneath him and throwing them out of the ring.

After Aang won the tournament by easily knocking Toph out of the ring with his airbending, The Hippo and the other wrestlers assisted Xin Fu in attempting to reclaim his prize money. After the group cornered Aang and Toph, The Hippo threw a metal cage over both of them, successfully capturing them.

After Toph's parents paid the ransom to free their daughter, Sokka and Katara attempted to rescue Aang as well but were stopped by the band of wrestlers. The Hippo proceeded to lift Aang's metal cage onto his shoulder to leave the arena and deliver him to the Fire Nation for the bounty. Toph challenged The Hippo and the other fighters, promising to defeat them all again if they refused to release Aang. Taking them on simultaneously, she succeeded in defeating each of them. The Boulder, The Hippo, and the Headhunter were the last fighters standing. The Hippo defended himself by swinging a large earthen model of the Earth Kingdom's national emblem. Working together with the other two, he charged Toph, but she defeated them by shifting the ground beneath their feet.
